hypothesis: The R2 training mixture underrepresents numeric fake (3.9% of train) and video-pattern real (6.1% of train) face crops; equal representation of the four observable strata (numeric real, numeric fake, video real, video fake) in a 20K sample may improve balanced accuracy and stratum recall without altering architecture or augmentation.
hypothesis_nature: Empirical engineering hypothesis regarding class and stratum distribution; not a certified source-held-out experiment or guaranteed generalization improvement.

shared_development_cohort.name: Shared Dev Partition
shared_development_cohort.constraint: Identical sample IDs and paths shared exactly across Arm A and Arm B evaluation

checkpoint_retention_and_selection.selection_policy: Monitor ROC AUC across 5 epochs; select best_dev.pth and preserve final_epoch_5.pth
checkpoint_retention_and_selection.strata_reporting: Report per-stratum recalls, balanced accuracy, and minimum stratum recall alongside overall metrics
checkpoint_retention_and_selection.threshold_policy: Primary evaluation at fixed 0.5 threshold; optional secondary threshold selected exclusively on dev partition and bound to checkpoint
